source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current browser test obtains a Wayland flag and expects a requested minimized state to remain normal on Wayland. It checks returned window properties directly; the historical version had bounded retrying checks. Preserve explicit platform expectations rather than treating every geometry delay as a reason to weaken assertions. No Linux, Wayland or window test ran. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Keep platform state exceptions visible in window tests
